purpose: Low-cost re-entry map for GitHub-connected agents. Resolve current main from GitHub; never trust an embedded commit SHA.
connector_rules: Freeze exact main HEAD and tree before substantive reads or staging.
Use search for discovery only; exact refs/blobs/files establish snapshot truth.
Batch independent reads against one pinned ref and serialize dependent writes.
Track read/write/dependency/protected sets only as ephemeral task state.
For coupled changes create one Git-object candidate commit from a fresh base tree.
Treat a moved main as awareness before conflict; compare accepted head directly with newest head.
Absorb useful concurrent work when it changes the active owner, test, implementation, or premise.
Never force-push; bounded publication churn preserves the staged overlay instead of restarting the task.
Validation is target-SHA-bound and only executed jobs/tests may be reported as passes.
Use open CODEX issues only for concrete capability debt that this connector/runtime cannot execute.
reentry_note: This file is a route index only. If it disagrees with a canonical owner, the canonical owner wins and this index must be repaired.
